IGUI_CHD_SpotNone: None yet: right click the ground > Cookie Horde
IGUI_CHD_Takes: Takes about %1 min. The spot is removed when all are out.
IGUI_CHD_PickFirst: Pick a spot to see the estimate.
IGUI_CHD_Expected: Up to %1 zombies around the spot if nobody kills any
IGUI_CHD_R_many: %1 zombies around one spot (lag starts above %2)
IGUI_CHD_R_pending: Other spots nearby still have %1 to let out
IGUI_CHD_R_rate: %1 zombies a minute from spots near each other
IGUI_CHD_R_seen: The nearest player is only %1 squares away: zombies pop up on screen and players' PCs stutter. %2+ squares is better
IGUI_CHD_ClearFirst: Let the players clear the area first
IGUI_CHD_LagNote: Advice only, it never stops a spawn. The numbers are a starting estimate and will be adjusted.
IGUI_CHD_WaitArea: waiting: nobody near, area not loaded
IGUI_CHD_HPTip: Zombie health times this. Hit strength cannot be set per zombie. Speed and sluggishness go back to the server setting if the area unloads and loads again.
IGUI_CHD_OutfitsEmpty: Empty = the game's random outfits. Type to search, click to add. Each zombie gets one of these at random.
IGUI_CHD_DropsEmpty: No drops. Type an item name to search, click to add.
IGUI_CHD_CancelTip: Stops letting zombies out. The ones already out stay.
IGUI_CHD_WaitFail: spawning failed, see the server log
IGUI_CHD_UsePresetTip: Uses the saved version. Save first if you changed something.
IGUI_CHD_SlowTip: Trial: slows the zombie's walking on every player's screen. Check it on the test server first.
IGUI_CHD_ResTip: How many of the zombies, at random, get the resistance below
IGUI_CHD_CutTip: Damage taken from this kind of hit. At most two kinds can be set to no damage, so the zombie still dies to the rest. Fire and cars are not covered.
